_comment: Co-op relay for the packaged desktop/Steam build. Empty = multiplayer disabled, solo play unaffected. Overridden at runtime by the MOJI_RELAY_URL env var, and at build time by the MOJI_RELAY_URL Actions variable (see .github/workflows/steam-build.yml). This is the Cloudflare Worker in mp-cf/ — no cold start, same host as the auth/save API. It replaced the Render free dyno after the Steam review could not connect to it (61s cold HTTP, no WS welcome in 120s). Verify with `node scripts/relay_health_check.mjs wss://mojiworld-mp.dpeh001.workers.dev` before shipping, and keep MP_FALLBACK_URL in mojiworld_game.html + DEFAULT_RELAY in deploy-pages.yml on the same host.
